HIWONDER_EMM_EN.longDesc: Enable the Hiwonder Encoder Motor Module (EMM) motor driver.
HIWONDER_EMM_EN.shortDesc: Enable the Hiwonder Encoder Motor Module (EMM) motor driver

HTE_ACC_GATE.longDesc:
Sets the number of standard deviations used
by the innovation consistency test.

HTE_HT_ERR_INIT.longDesc:
Sets the number of standard deviations used
by the innovation consistency test.

HTE_HT_NOISE.longDesc:
Reduce to make the hover thrust estimate
more stable, increase if the real hover thrust
is expected to change quickly over time.

HTE_THR_RANGE.longDesc:
Defines the range of the hover thrust estimate around MPC_THR_HOVER.
A value of 0.2 with MPC_THR_HOVER at 0.5 results in a range of [0.3, 0.7].

Set to a large value if the vehicle operates in varying physical conditions that
affect the required hover thrust strongly (e.g. differently sized payloads).

HTE_VXY_THR.longDesc:
Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased
to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement.

Set to a low value on vehicles with large lifting surfaces.
HTE_VXY_THR.shortDesc: Horizontal velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction

HTE_VZ_THR.longDesc:
Above this speed, the measurement noise is linearly increased
to reduce the sensitivity of the estimator from biased measurement.

Set to a low value on vehicles affected by air drag when climbing or descending.
HTE_VZ_THR.shortDesc: Vertical velocity threshold for sensitivity reduction

ICE_IDLE_RPM.longDesc: Idle RPM setpoint for the engine. Applies a controller to prevent the RPM do drop below this value.
ICE_IDLE_RPM.shortDesc: Idle RPM setpoint for the engine

ICE_IDLE_RPM_I.longDesc: Ratio between integrated RPM error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.
ICE_IDLE_RPM_I.shortDesc: Integral gain for idle RPM control

ICE_IDLE_RPM_P.longDesc: Ratio between RPM error devided by 1000 to how much normalized output gets added to correct for it.
ICE_IDLE_RPM_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for idle RPM control

ICE_IDLE_THR_FF.longDesc: Used as feed-forward. Should match approximately the throttle required to maintain the ICE_IDLE_RPM.

ICE_IGN_DELAY.longDesc: In case that the ignition takes a moment to be up and running, this parameter can be set to account for that.
ICE_IGN_DELAY.shortDesc: Cold-start delay after ignition before engaging starter

ICE_MIN_RUN_RPM.shortDesc: Minimum RPM for engine to be declared running

ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.longDesc:
Enables restart if a fault is detected during the running state. Otherwise
commands continues in running state until given an user request off.
ICE_RUN_FAULT_D.shortDesc: Fault detection if it stops in running state

ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.longDesc: Number of accepted attempts for starting the engine before declaring a fault.
ICE_STRT_ATTEMPT.shortDesc: Number attempts for starting the engine

ICE_STRT_DUR.longDesc: Maximum expected time for startup before declaring timeout.
ICE_STRT_DUR.shortDesc: Duration of single starting attempt (excl. choking)

ICE_STRT_THR.longDesc: During the choking and the starting phase, the throttle value is set to this value.

ICE_THR_SLEW.longDesc: Maximum rate of change of throttle value per second.

ILABS_MODE.longDesc:
Configures whether the driver outputs only raw sensor output (the default),
or additionally supplies INS data such as position and velocity estimates.

IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF.longDesc:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary accelerometer.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators. 0 disables the filter.
IMU_ACCEL_CUTOFF.shortDesc: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for accel

IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.longDesc:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter used on
the time derivative of the measured angular velocity, also known as
the D-term filter in the rate controller. The D-term uses the derivative of
the rate and thus is the most susceptible to noise. Therefore, using
a D-term filter allows to increase IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF, which
leads to reduced control latency and permits to increase the P gains.

A value of 0 disables the filter.
IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.shortDesc: Cutoff frequency for angular acceleration (D-Term filter)

IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF.longDesc:
The cutoff frequency for the 2nd order butterworth filter on the primary gyro.
This only affects the angular velocity sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
It applies also to the angular acceleration (D-Term filter), see IMU_DGYRO_CUTOFF.

A value of 0 disables the filter.
IMU_GYRO_CUTOFF.shortDesc: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for gyro

IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW.longDesc: Bandwidth per notch filter when using dynamic notch filtering with ESC RPM.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_BW.shortDesc: IMU gyro ESC notch filter bandwidth

IMU_GYRO_DNF_EN.longDesc:
Enable bank of dynamically updating notch filters.
Requires ESC RPM feedback or onboard FFT (IMU_GYRO_FFT_EN).

IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC.longDesc: ESC RPM number of harmonics (multiples of RPM) for ESC RPM dynamic notch filtering.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_HMC.shortDesc: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter harmonics

IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN.longDesc: Minimum notch filter frequency in Hz.
IMU_GYRO_DNF_MIN.shortDesc: IMU gyro dynamic notch filter minimum frequency

IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW.longDesc:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

IMU_GYRO_NF0_FRQ.longDesc:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF0_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW.longDesc:
The frequency width of the stop band for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ" to activate the filter and to set the notch frequency.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.

IMU_GYRO_NF1_FRQ.longDesc:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the primary gyro.
This filter can be enabled to avoid feedback amplification of structural resonances at a specific frequency.
This only affects the signal sent to the controllers, not the estimators.
Applies to both angular velocity and angular acceleration sent to the controllers.
See "IMU_GYRO_NF1_BW" to set the bandwidth of the filter.

A value of 0 disables the filter.

IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX.longDesc:
The maximum rate the gyro control data (vehicle_angular_velocity) will be
allowed to publish at. This is the loop rate for the rate controller and outputs.

Note: sensor data is always read and filtered at the full raw rate (eg commonly 8 kHz) regardless of this setting.
IMU_GYRO_RATEMAX.shortDesc: Gyro control data maximum publication rate (inner loop rate)

IMU_INTEG_RATE.longDesc:
The rate at which raw IMU data is integrated to produce delta angles and delta velocities.
Recommended to set this to a multiple of the estimator update period (currently 10 ms for ekf2).

INA220_CUR_BAT.shortDesc: INA220 Power Monitor Battery Max Current

INA220_CUR_REG.shortDesc: INA220 Power Monitor Regulator Max Current

ISBD_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run Iridium (with MAVLink).

ISBD_READ_INT.longDesc: Satellite radio read interval. Only required to be nonzero if data is not sent using a ring call

ISBD_STACK_TIME.longDesc:
Time the Iridium driver will wait for additional mavlink messages to combine them into one SBD message

Value 0 turns the functionality off
ISBD_STACK_TIME.shortDesc: Iridium SBD message stacking wait time

LNDFW_AIRSPD_MAX.longDesc: Maximum airspeed allowed in the landed state

LNDFW_ROT_MAX.longDesc:
Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity in the landed state.
Only used if neither airspeed nor groundspeed can be used for landing detection.
LNDFW_ROT_MAX.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: max rotational speed

LNDFW_TRIG_TIME.longDesc: Time the land conditions (speeds and acceleration) have to be satisfied to detect a landing.

LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX.longDesc:
Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state.
A factor of 0.7 is applied in case of airspeed-less flying
(either because no sensor is present or sensor data got invalid in flight).
LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal velocity threshold

LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX.longDesc: Maximum vertical velocity allowed in the landed state.
LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max vertiacal velocity threshold

LNDFW_XYACC_MAX.longDesc: Maximum horizontal (x,y body axes) acceleration allowed in the landed state
LNDFW_XYACC_MAX.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal acceleration

LNDMC_ALT_GND.longDesc:
The height above ground below which ground effect creates barometric altitude errors.
A negative value indicates no ground effect.

LNDMC_ROT_MAX.longDesc: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity (roll, pitch) in the landed state.

LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX.longDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state

LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX.longDesc:
Vertical velocity threshold to detect landing.
Has to be set lower than the expected minimal speed for landing,
which is either MPC_LAND_SPEED or MPC_LAND_CRWL.
This is enforced by an automatic check.

LND_FLIGHT_T_HI.longDesc:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Higher 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.longDesc:
Total flight time of this autopilot. Lower 32 bits of the value.
Flight time in microseconds = (LND_FLIGHT_T_HI << 32) | LND_FLIGHT_T_LO.

LPE_ACC_XY.longDesc:
Data sheet noise density = 150ug/sqrt(Hz) = 0.0015 m/s^2/sqrt(Hz)

Larger than data sheet to account for tilt error.

LPE_BAR_Z.shortDesc: Barometric pressure altitude z standard deviation

LPE_EPH_MAX.shortDesc: Max EPH allowed for GPS initialization

LPE_EPV_MAX.shortDesc: Max EPV allowed for GPS initialization

LPE_FAKE_ORIGIN.longDesc:
Enable publishing of a fake global position (e.g for AUTO missions using Optical Flow)

By initializing the estimator to the LPE_LAT/LON parameters when global information is unavailable
LPE_FAKE_ORIGIN.shortDesc: Enable fake global position for optical flow

LPE_FGYRO_HP.shortDesc: Flow gyro high pass filter cut off frequency

LPE_FLW_OFF_Z.shortDesc: Optical flow z offset from center

LPE_FLW_RR.shortDesc: Optical flow angular velocity noise gain

bitmask.description: fuse GPS, requires GPS for alt. init

LPE_FUSION.longDesc:
Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Set to true to fuse GPS data if available, also requires GPS for altitude init
1 : Set to true to fuse optical flow data if available
2 : Set to true to fuse vision position
3 : Set to true to enable landing target
4 : Set to true to fuse land detector
5 : Set to true to publish AGL as local position down component
6 : Set to true to enable flow gyro compensation
7 : Set to true to enable baro fusion

default (145 - GPS, baro, land detector)

LPE_GPS_VXY.longDesc: EPV used if greater than this value.

LPE_GPS_XY.shortDesc: Minimum GPS xy standard deviation, uses reported EPH if greater

LPE_GPS_Z.shortDesc: Minimum GPS z standard deviation, uses reported EPV if greater

LPE_LAND_VXY.shortDesc: Land detector xy velocity standard deviation

LPE_LAT.shortDesc: Local origin latitude for nav w/o GPS

LPE_LDR_OFF_Z.shortDesc: Lidar z offset from center of vehicle +down

LPE_LON.shortDesc: Local origin longitude for nav w/o GPS

LPE_LT_COV.longDesc: Minimum landing target standard covariance, uses reported covariance if greater

LPE_PN_P.longDesc:
Increase to trust measurements more.
Decrease to trust model more.

LPE_PN_T.longDesc: Terrain random walk noise density, hilly/outdoor (0.1), flat/Indoor (0.001)

LPE_PN_V.longDesc:
Increase to trust measurements more.
Decrease to trust model more.

LPE_SNR_OFF_Z.shortDesc: Sonar z offset from center of vehicle +down

LPE_T_MAX_GRADE.longDesc:
Terrain maximum percent grade, hilly/outdoor (100 = 45 deg), flat/Indoor (0 = 0 deg)

Used to calculate increased terrain random walk noise due to movement.

LPE_VIS_DELAY.longDesc: Set to zero to enable automatic compensation from measurement timestamps

LPE_VXY_PUB.shortDesc: Required velocity xy standard deviation to publish position

LPE_Z_PUB.shortDesc: Required z standard deviation to publish altitude/ terrain

LTEST_ACC_UNC.longDesc:
Variance of acceleration measurement used for landing target position prediction.
Higher values results in tighter following of the measurements and more lenient outlier rejection

LTEST_MEAS_UNC.longDesc:
Variance of the landing target measurement from the driver.
Higher values result in less aggressive following of the measurement and a smoother output as well as fewer rejected measurements.

LTEST_MODE.longDesc:
Configure the mode of the landing target. Depending on the mode, the landing target observations are used differently to aid position estimation.

Mode Moving:     The landing target may be moving around while in the field of view of the vehicle. Landing target measurements are not used to aid positioning.
Mode Stationary: The landing target is stationary. Measured velocity w.r.t. the landing target is used to aid velocity estimation.

LTEST_POS_UNC_IN.longDesc: Initial variance of the relative landing target position in x and y direction

LTEST_SCALE_X.longDesc: Landing target x measurements are scaled by this factor before being used
LTEST_SCALE_X.shortDesc: Scale factor for sensor measurements in sensor x axis

LTEST_SCALE_Y.longDesc: Landing target y measurements are scaled by this factor before being used
LTEST_SCALE_Y.shortDesc: Scale factor for sensor measurements in sensor y axis

LTEST_SENS_POS_X.shortDesc: X Position of IRLOCK in body frame (forward)

LTEST_SENS_POS_Y.shortDesc: Y Position of IRLOCK in body frame (right)

LTEST_SENS_POS_Z.shortDesc: Z Position of IRLOCK in body frame (downward)

LTEST_SENS_ROT.shortDesc: Rotation of IRLOCK sensor relative to airframe

LTEST_VEL_UNC_IN.longDesc: Initial variance of the relative landing target velocity in x and y directions

MAN_ARM_GESTURE.longDesc:
This determines if moving the left stick to the lower right
arms and to the lower left disarms the vehicle.

MAN_DEADZONE.longDesc:
Range around stick center ignored to prevent
vehicle drift from stick hardware inaccuracy.

Does not apply to any precise constant input like
throttle and attitude or rate piloting.
MAN_DEADZONE.shortDesc: Deadzone for sticks (only specific use cases)

MAN_KILL_GEST_T.longDesc:
The timeout for holding the left stick to the lower left
and the right stick to the lower right at the same time until the gesture
kills the actuators one-way.

A negative value disables the feature.
MAN_KILL_GEST_T.shortDesc: Trigger time for kill stick gesture

MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD.longDesc: Stick velocity above which the pilot regains control by switching to Position mode (or Altitude if position is unavailable). Unit: normalized stick travel per second — at 1.0, moving a stick half its range in ~0.5s triggers it. A negative value disables the feature. Only applies to multicopters and VTOLs in MC mode.

MAV_0_BROADCAST.longDesc:
This allows a ground control station to automatically find the drone
on the local network.
MAV_0_BROADCAST.shortDesc: Broadcast heartbeats on local network for MAVLink instance 0

MAV_0_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run MAVLink.

MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL.longDesc:
This is used to force flow control on or off for the the mavlink
instance. By default it is auto detected. Use when auto detection fails.
MAV_0_FLOW_CTRL.shortDesc: Enable serial flow control for instance 0

MAV_0_FORWARD.longDesc:
If enabled, forward incoming MAVLink messages to other MAVLink ports if the
message is either broadcast or the target is not the autopilot.

This allows for example a GCS to talk to a camera that is connected to the
autopilot via MAVLink (on a different link than the GCS).
MAV_0_FORWARD.shortDesc: Enable MAVLink Message forwarding for instance 0

MAV_0_HL_FREQ.longDesc:
Positive real value that configures the transmission frequency of the
HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0, configured in iridium mode.
This parameter has no effect if the instance mode is different from iridium.
MAV_0_HL_FREQ.shortDesc: Configures the frequency of HIGH_LATENCY2 stream for instance 0

MAV_0_MODE.longDesc:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.

MAV_0_RADIO_CTL.longDesc:
If enabled, MAVLink messages will be throttled according to
`txbuf` field reported by radio_status.

Requires a radio to send the mavlink message RADIO_STATUS.
MAV_0_RADIO_CTL.shortDesc: Enable software throttling of mavlink on instance 0

MAV_0_RATE.longDesc:
Configure the maximum sending rate for the MAVLink streams in Bytes/sec.
If the configured streams exceed the maximum rate, the sending rate of
each stream is automatically decreased.

If this is set to 0 a value of half of the theoretical maximum bandwidth is used.
This corresponds to baudrate/20 Bytes/s (baudrate/10 = maximum data rate on
8N1-configured links).
MAV_0_RATE.shortDesc: Maximum MAVLink sending rate for instance 0

MAV_0_REMOTE_PRT.longDesc:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected remote port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

MAV_0_UDP_PRT.longDesc:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 0,
selected udp port will be set and used in MAVLink instance 0.

MAV_2_UDP_PRT.longDesc:
If ethernet enabled and selected as configuration for MAVLink instance 2,

MAV_FWDEXTSP.longDesc:
If set to 1 incoming external setpoint messages will be directly forwarded
to the controllers if in offboard control mode

MAV_HASH_CHK_EN.longDesc:
Disabling the parameter hash check functionality will make the mavlink instance
stream parameters continuously.

MAV_HB_FORW_EN.longDesc:
The mavlink heartbeat message will not be forwarded if this parameter is set to 'disabled'.
The main reason for disabling heartbeats to be forwarded is because they confuse dronekit.

values.description: Version 1 with auto-upgrade to v2 if detected

MAV_RADIO_TOUT.longDesc:
If the connected radio stops reporting RADIO_STATUS for a certain time,
a warning is triggered and, if MAV_X_RADIO_CTL is enabled, the software-flow
control is reset.
MAV_RADIO_TOUT.shortDesc: Timeout in seconds for the RADIO_STATUS reports coming in

MAV_SIK_RADIO_ID.longDesc:
When non-zero the MAVLink app will attempt to configure the
SiK radio to this ID and re-set the parameter to 0. If the value
is negative it will reset the complete radio config to
factory defaults. Only applies if this mavlink instance is going through a SiK radio

MAV_S_MODE.longDesc:
The MAVLink Mode defines the set of streamed messages (for example the
vehicle's attitude) and their sending rates.
MAV_S_MODE.shortDesc: MAVLink Mode for SOM to FMU communication channel

values.description: VTOL Standard (separate fixed rotors for hover and cruise flight)

MAV_USEHILGPS.longDesc: If set to 1 incoming HIL GPS messages are parsed.
MAV_USEHILGPS.shortDesc: Use/Accept HIL GPS message even if not in HIL mode

MBE_ENABLE.longDesc:
This enables continuous calibration of the magnetometers
before takeoff using gyro data.

MBE_LEARN_GAIN.longDesc:
Increase to make the estimator more responsive
Decrease to make the estimator more robust to noise

MC_ACRO_EXPO.longDesc:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve
MC_ACRO_EXPO.shortDesc: Acro mode roll, pitch expo factor

MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y.longDesc:
Exponential factor for tuning the input curve shape.

0 Purely linear input curve
1 Purely cubic input curve

MC_ACRO_P_MAX.longDesc: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_ACRO_R_MAX.longDesc: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO.longDesc:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO.

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect
MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO.shortDesc: Acro mode roll, pitch super expo factor

MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY.longDesc:
"Superexponential" factor for refining the input curve shape tuned using MC_ACRO_EXPO_Y.

0 Pure Expo function
0.7 reasonable shape enhancement for intuitive stick feel
0.95 very strong bent input curve only near maxima have effect
MC_ACRO_SUPEXPOY.shortDesc: Acro mode yaw super expo factor

MC_ACRO_Y_MAX.longDesc: Full stick deflection leads to this rate.

MC_AIRMODE.longDesc:
The air-mode enables the mixer to increase the total thrust of the multirotor
in order to keep attitude and rate control even at low and high throttle.

This function should be disabled during tuning as it will help the controller
to diverge if the closed-loop is unstable (i.e. the vehicle is not tuned yet).

Enabling air-mode for yaw requires the use of an arming switch.

MC_AT_APPLY.longDesc:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.

WARNING Applying the gains in air is dangerous as there is no
guarantee that those new gains will be able to stabilize
the drone properly.
MC_AT_APPLY.shortDesc: Controls when to apply the new gains

values.description: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
Apply the new gains after disarm
WARNING Apply the new gains in air

MC_AT_RISE_TIME.shortDesc: Desired angular rate closed-loop rise time

MC_BAT_SCALE_EN.longDesc:
This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to
normalize performance across the operating range of the battery. The copter
should constantly behave as if it was fully charged with reduced max acceleration
at lower battery percentages. i.e. if hover is at 0.5 throttle at 100% battery,
it will still be 0.5 at 60% battery.

MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.longDesc: Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter
MC_MAN_TILT_TAU.shortDesc: Manual tilt input filter time constant

MC_NN_EN.shortDesc: If true the neural network control is automatically started on boot

MC_NN_MANL_CTRL.shortDesc: Enable or disable setting the trajectory setpoint with manual control

MC_NN_MAX_RPM.longDesc: The maximum RPM of the motors. Used to normalize the output of the neural network
MC_NN_MAX_RPM.shortDesc: Max motor RPM for neural network normalization

MC_NN_MIN_RPM.longDesc: The minimum RPM of the motors. Used to normalize the output of the neural network
MC_NN_MIN_RPM.shortDesc: Min motor RPM for neural network normalization

MC_NN_THRST_COEF.longDesc: Thrust coefficient of the motors. Used to normalize the output of the neural network. Divided by 100 000
MC_NN_THRST_COEF.shortDesc: Motor thrust coefficient for NN normalization

MC_PITCHRATE_D.longDesc: Pitch rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_PITCHRATE_I.longDesc: Pitch rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_PITCHRATE_K.longDesc:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
```
output = MC_PITCHRATE_K * (MC_PITCHRATE_P * error
+ MC_PITCHRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_PITCHRATE_D * error_derivative)
```
Set MC_PITCHRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_PITCHRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_PITCHRATE_MAX.longDesc:
Limit for pitch rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum
measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_PITCHRATE_P.longDesc: Pitch rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_PITCH_P.longDesc: Pitch proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_PR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Pitch rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large pitch moment trim changes.

MC_RAPTOR_ENABLE.longDesc: When enabled, the Raptor flight mode will be available. Please set MC_RAPTOR_OFFB according to your use case.

MC_RAPTOR_INTREF.longDesc:
When enabled, instead of using the trajectory_setpoint, the position and yaw of the vehicle at the point when the Raptor mode is activated will be used as reference.
Use `mc_raptor intref lissajous <A> <B> <C> <fa> <fb> <fc> <duration> <ramp>` to configure the trajectory.
MC_RAPTOR_INTREF.shortDesc: Use internal reference instead of trajectory_setpoint

MC_RAPTOR_OFFB.longDesc:
When enabled, the Raptor mode will replace the Offboard mode.
If disabled, the Raptor mode will be available as a separate external mode. In the latter case, Raptor will just hold the position, without requiring external setpoints. When Raptor replaces the Offboard mode, it requires external setpoints to be activated.

MC_RAPTOR_VERBOS.longDesc: When enabled, the Raptor flight mode will print verbose output to the console.

MC_REF_FF.longDesc: Scale on the reference-model rate feed-forward. 0 disables it.

MC_REF_FF_MAX.longDesc: Per-axis cap on the rate feed-forward.

MC_REF_W_N.longDesc:
Bandwidth of the reference model that smooths the attitude setpoint
and generates the rate feed-forward. Higher = less lag, more peak
rate demand.

MC_ROLLRATE_D.longDesc: Roll rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_ROLLRATE_I.longDesc: Roll rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_ROLLRATE_K.longDesc:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
```
output = MC_ROLLRATE_K * (MC_ROLLRATE_P * error
+ MC_ROLLRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_ROLLRATE_D * error_derivative)
```
Set MC_ROLLRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_ROLLRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_ROLLRATE_MAX.longDesc:
Limit for roll rate in manual and auto modes (except acro).
Has effect for large rotations in autonomous mode, to avoid large control
output and mixer saturation.

This is not only limited by the vehicle's properties, but also by the maximum
measurement rate of the gyro.

MC_ROLLRATE_P.longDesc: Roll rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_ROLL_P.longDesc: Roll proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_RR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Roll rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large roll moment trim changes.

MC_SLOW_DEF_HVEL.longDesc:
This value is used in slow mode if
no aux channel is mapped and
no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_DEF_VVEL.longDesc:
This value is used in slow mode if
no aux channel is mapped and
no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_DEF_YAWR.longDesc:
This value is used in slow mode if
no aux channel is mapped and
no limit is commanded through MAVLink.

MC_SLOW_MAP_HVEL.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale horizontal velocity in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_PTCH.longDesc: RC_MAP_AUX{N} to allow for gimbal pitch rate control in position slow mode
MC_SLOW_MAP_PTCH.shortDesc: Gimbal pitch rate control input in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_VVEL.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale vertical velocity in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MAP_YAWR.shortDesc: Manual input mapped to scale yaw rate in position slow mode

MC_SLOW_MIN_HVEL.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_VVEL.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this velocity.

MC_SLOW_MIN_YAWR.longDesc: The lowest input maps and is clamped to this rate.

MC_YAWRATE_D.longDesc: Yaw rate differential gain. Small values help reduce fast oscillations. If value is too big oscillations will appear again.

MC_YAWRATE_I.longDesc: Yaw rate integral gain. Can be set to compensate static thrust difference or gravity center offset.

MC_YAWRATE_K.longDesc:
Global gain of the controller.

This gain scales the P, I and D terms of the controller:
```
output = MC_YAWRATE_K * (MC_YAWRATE_P * error
+ MC_YAWRATE_I * error_integral
+ MC_YAWRATE_D * error_derivative)
```
Set MC_YAWRATE_P=1 to implement a PID in the ideal form.
Set MC_YAWRATE_K=1 to implement a PID in the parallel form.

MC_YAWRATE_P.longDesc: Yaw rate proportional gain, i.e. control output for angular speed error 1 rad/s.

MC_YAW_P.longDesc: Yaw proportional gain, i.e. desired angular speed in rad/s for error 1 rad.

MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.longDesc:
Reduces vibrations by lowering high frequency torque caused by rotor acceleration.
0 disables the filter
MC_YAW_TQ_CUTOFF.shortDesc: Low pass filter cutoff frequency for yaw torque setpoint

MC_YAW_WEIGHT.longDesc:
A fraction [0,1] deprioritizing yaw compared to roll and pitch in non-linear attitude control.
Deprioritizing yaw is necessary because multicopters have much less control authority
in yaw compared to the other axes and it makes sense because yaw is not critical for
stable hovering or 3D navigation.

For yaw control tuning use MC_YAW_P. This ratio has no impact on the yaw gain.

MC_YR_INT_LIM.longDesc: Yaw rate integrator limit. Can be set to increase the amount of integrator available to counteract disturbances or reduced to improve settling time after large yaw moment trim changes.

MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.longDesc:
Ensure:
gripper: NAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
has released before continuing mission.
winch: CMD_DO_WINCH
has delivered before continuing mission.
gimbal: CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW
has reached the commanded orientation before beginning to take pictures.
MIS_COMMAND_TOUT.shortDesc: Timeout to allow the payload to execute the mission command

MIS_DIST_1WP.longDesc:
There will be a warning message if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIST_1WP from Home.
Has no effect on mission validity.
Set a value of zero or less to disable.
MIS_DIST_1WP.shortDesc: Maximal horizontal distance from Home to first waypoint

MIS_LND_ABRT_ALT.longDesc:
Minimum altitude above landing point that the vehicle will climb to after an aborted landing.
Then vehicle will loiter in this altitude until further command is received.
Used as the default when the landing mission item does not specify its own abort altitude
(MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND param1).
Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles.

MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.longDesc:
Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items)

If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction.
If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.
MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL.shortDesc: Enable gimbal yaw control in missions

MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT.longDesc:
This is the relative altitude the system will take off to
if not otherwise specified.

MIS_TKO_LAND_REQ.longDesc:
Specifies if a mission has to contain a takeoff and/or mission landing.
Validity of configured takeoffs/landings is checked independently of the setting here.

values.description: Require a takeoff and a landing
Require both a takeoff and a landing, or neither
Same as previous when landed, in-air require landing only if no valid VTOL approach is present

MIS_YAW_ERR.shortDesc: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance

MIS_YAW_TMT.longDesc:
Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced

If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the
waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition.
Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target
yaw in wind. Disabled by default.

MNT_DO_STAB.longDesc:
Set to true for servo gimbal, false for passthrough.
This is required for a gimbal which is not capable of stabilizing itself
and relies on the IMU's attitude estimation.

MNT_FIXED_PITCH.shortDesc: Tracked pitch angle when in fixed mode (MNT_MODE_IN=5)

MNT_MAN_PITCH.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control pitch (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_ROLL.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control roll (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAN_YAW.shortDesc: Auxiliary channel to control yaw (in AUX input or manual mode)

MNT_MAV_COMPID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink protocol v2, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this component ID.
MNT_MAV_COMPID.shortDesc: Mavlink Component ID of the mount

MNT_MAV_SYSID.longDesc: If MNT_MODE_OUT is MAVLink gimbal protocol v1, mount configure/control commands will be sent with this target ID.
MNT_MAV_SYSID.shortDesc: Mavlink System ID of the mount

MNT_MAX_PITCH.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).
MNT_MAX_PITCH.shortDesc: Max positive angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)

MNT_MIN_PITCH.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX).
MNT_MIN_PITCH.shortDesc: Min negative angle of pitch setpoint (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)

MNT_MODE_IN.longDesc:
This is the protocol used between the ground station and the autopilot.

Recommended is Auto, RC only or MAVLink gimbal protocol v2.
The rest will be deprecated.

values.description: Auto (RC and MAVLink gimbal protocol v2)
Fixed world-frame attitude, not user controllable

MNT_MODE_OUT.longDesc:
This is the protocol used between the autopilot and a connected gimbal.

Recommended is the MAVLink gimbal protocol v2 if the gimbal supports it.

MNT_RANGE_ROLL.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX). Note that only symmetric angular ranges are supported.
MNT_RANGE_ROLL.shortDesc: Range of roll channel output (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)

MNT_RANGE_YAW.longDesc: Use output driver settings to calibrate (e.g. PWM_CENT/_MIN/_MAX). Note that only symmetric angular ranges are supported.
MNT_RANGE_YAW.shortDesc: Range of yaw channel output (only in MNT_MODE_OUT=AUX)

MNT_RATE_PITCH.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-pitch rate..pitch rate].
MNT_RATE_PITCH.shortDesc: Angular pitch rate for manual input in degrees/second

MNT_RATE_YAW.longDesc: Full stick input [-1..1] translats to [-yaw rate..yaw rate].
MNT_RATE_YAW.shortDesc: Angular yaw rate for manual input in degrees/second

MNT_RC_IN_MODE.shortDesc: Input mode for RC gimbal input

MNT_TAU.longDesc:
Alpha filter time constant defining the convergence rate (in seconds) for open-loop AUX mount control

Use when no angular position feedback is available.
With MNT_MODE_OUT set to AUX, the mount operates in open-loop and directly commands the servo output.
Parameters must be tuned for the specific servo to approximate its speed and response.
MNT_TAU.shortDesc: Time constant for open-loop AUX gimbal control

MODALAI_CONFIG.longDesc:
This can be set to indicate that drone behavior
needs to be changed to match a custom setting

MOTFAIL_C2T.longDesc:
Determines the slope between expected steady state current and linearized, normalized thrust command.
E.g. FD_ACT_MOT_C2T A represents the expected steady state current at 100%.
FD_ACT_LOW_OFF and FD_ACT_HIGH_OFF offset the threshold from that slope.

MOTFAIL_OFF.longDesc: Check is triggered if `abs(FD_ACT_MOT_C2T * thrust - FD_ACT_OFF)` is above this value.

MOTFAIL_TIME.longDesc: Motor failure only triggers after current thresholds are exceeded for this time.

MPC_ACC_DECOUPLE.longDesc:
Set to decouple tilt from vertical acceleration.
This provides smoother flight but slightly worse tracking in position and auto modes.
Unset if accurate position tracking during dynamic maneuvers is more important than a smooth flight.

MPC_ACC_DOWN_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum downwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_ACC_HOR.longDesc: When piloting manually, this parameter is only used in MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.
MPC_ACC_HOR.shortDesc: Acceleration for autonomous and for manual modes

MPC_ACC_HOR_MAX.longDesc:
MPC_POS_MODE
1 just deceleration
4 not used, use MPC_ACC_HOR instead

MPC_ACC_UP_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum upwards acceleration in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_ALT_MODE.longDesc:
Control height
0: relative earth frame origin which may drift due to sensors
1: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) which changes with terrain variation.
It will revert to relative earth frame if the distance to ground estimate becomes invalid.
2: relative to ground (requires distance sensor) when stationary
and relative to earth frame when moving horizontally.
The speed threshold is MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY

MPC_AUTO_NUDGING.longDesc:
Bitmask to enable pilot override of heading and position during auto modes.

Bit 0 - Yaw nudging: yaw stick rotates the heading in all auto types
(takeoff, mission, RTL, hold, landing). The new heading is held until a
mode switch resets it.

Bit 1 - Land nudging: during autonomous landing the pitch/roll sticks move
the vehicle horizontally, the throttle stick amends the descent speed
(stick full up: 0, centered: MPC_LAND_SPEED, full down: 2 * MPC_LAND_SPEED),
and the yaw stick rotates the heading.

Stick override must be disabled (set MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD = -1).
MPC_AUTO_NUDGING.shortDesc: Enable stick nudging in autonomous modes

MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.longDesc:
Maximum horizontal velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Direct velocity or MPC_ALT_MODE 2
MPC_HOLD_MAX_XY.shortDesc: Max horizontal velocity for position hold

MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z.longDesc:
Maximum vertical velocity for which position hold is enabled (use 0 to disable check)

Only used with MPC_ALT_MODE 1
MPC_HOLD_MAX_Z.shortDesc: Max vertical velocity for position hold

MPC_JERK_AUTO.longDesc:
Limit the maximum jerk of the vehicle (how fast the acceleration can change).
A lower value leads to smoother vehicle motions but also limited agility.

MPC_JERK_MAX.longDesc:
Limit the maximum jerk (acceleration change) of the vehicle.
A lower value leads to smoother motions but limits agility.

Setting this to the maximum value essentially disables the limit.

Only used with MPC_POS_MODE Acceleration based.
MPC_JERK_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal and vertical jerk in Position/Altitude mode

MPC_LAND_ALT1.longDesc:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets limited to a value
between "MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN" (or "MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN") and "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be higher than "MPC_LAND_ALT2"
MPC_LAND_ALT1.shortDesc: Altitude for 1. step of slow landing (descend)

MPC_LAND_ALT2.longDesc:
Below this altitude descending velocity gets
limited to "MPC_LAND_SPEED"
Value needs to be lower than "MPC_LAND_ALT1"
MPC_LAND_ALT2.shortDesc: Altitude for 2. step of slow landing (landing)

MPC_LAND_ALT3.longDesc:
If a valid distance sensor measurement to the ground is available,
limit descending velocity to "MPC_LAND_CRWL" below this altitude.
MPC_LAND_ALT3.shortDesc: Altitude for 3. step of slow landing

MPC_LAND_CRWL.longDesc: Used below MPC_LAND_ALT3 if distance sensor data is availabe.

MPC_LAND_RADIUS.longDesc:
When landing nudging is enabled (MPC_AUTO_NUDGING bit 1), this defines the maximum
allowed horizontal displacement from the original landing point.
- If inside of the radius, only allow nudging inputs that do not move the vehicle outside of it.
- If outside of the radius, only allow nudging inputs that move the vehicle back towards it.

Set it to -1 for infinite radius.

MPC_MANTHR_MIN.longDesc:
The value is mapped to the lowest throttle stick position in Stabilized mode.

Too low collective thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
Airmode is used to keep torque authority with zero thrust (see MC_AIRMODE).
MPC_MANTHR_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum collective thrust in Stabilized mode

MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX.shortDesc: Maximal tilt angle in Stabilized, Altitude and Altitude Cruise mode

MPC_MAN_Y_MAX.shortDesc: Max manual yaw rate for Stabilized, Altitude, Position mode

MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.longDesc:
Not used in Stabilized mode
Setting this parameter to 0 disables the filter
MPC_MAN_Y_TAU.shortDesc: Manual yaw rate input filter time constant

MPC_POS_MODE.longDesc:
The supported sub-modes are:
Direct velocity:
Sticks directly map to velocity setpoints without smoothing.
Also applies to vertical direction and Altitude mode.
Useful for velocity control tuning.
Acceleration based:
Sticks map to acceleration and there's a virtual brake drag

MPC_THR_CURVE.longDesc:
Defines how the throttle stick is mapped to collective thrust in Stabilized mode.

Rescale to hover thrust estimate:
Stick input is linearly rescaled, such that a centered throttle stick corresponds to the hover thrust estimator's output.

No rescale:
Directly map the stick 1:1 to the output.
Can be useful with very low hover thrust which leads to much distortion and the upper half getting sensitive.

Rescale to hover thrust parameter:
Similar to rescaling to the hover thrust estimate, but it uses the hover thrust parameter value (see MPC_THR_HOVER) instead of estimated value.
With MPC_THR_HOVER 0.5 it's equivalent to No rescale.
MPC_THR_CURVE.shortDesc: Thrust curve mapping in Stabilized Mode

MPC_THR_HOVER.longDesc:
Mapped to center throttle stick in Stabilized mode (see MPC_THR_CURVE).
Used for initialization of the hover thrust estimator.
The estimated hover thrust is used as base for zero vertical acceleration in altitude control.
The hover thrust is important for land detection to work correctly.

MPC_THR_MAX.longDesc: Limit allowed thrust e.g. for indoor test of overpowered vehicle.
MPC_THR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_THR_MIN.longDesc:
Too low thrust leads to loss of roll/pitch/yaw torque control authority.
With airmode enabled this parameters can be set to 0
while still keeping torque authority (see MC_AIRMODE).
MPC_THR_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum collective thrust in climb rate controlled modes

MPC_THR_XY_MARG.longDesc:
Margin that is kept for horizontal control when higher priority vertical thrust is saturated.
To avoid completely starving horizontal control with high vertical error.

MPC_TILTMAX_AIR.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all velocity or acceleration controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_TILTMAX_LND.longDesc: Tighter tilt limit during takeoff to avoid tip over.
MPC_TILTMAX_LND.shortDesc: Maximum tilt during inital takeoff ramp

MPC_TKO_RAMP_T.longDesc:
Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower.
If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over.
A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

MPC_VELD_LP.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.
MPC_VELD_LP.shortDesc: Velocity derivative low pass cutoff frequency

MPC_VEL_LP.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_MANUAL.longDesc:
Must be smaller than MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.

The maximum sideways and backward speed can be set differently
using MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE and MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK, respectively.
MPC_VEL_MANUAL.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity setpoint in Position mode

MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.longDesc:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.
MPC_VEL_MAN_BACK.shortDesc: Maximum backward velocity in Position mode

MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.longDesc:
If set to a negative value or larger than
MPC_VEL_MANUAL then MPC_VEL_MANUAL is used.
MPC_VEL_MAN_SIDE.shortDesc: Maximum sideways velocity in Position mode

MPC_VEL_NF_BW.longDesc: A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_VEL_NF_FRQ.longDesc:
The center frequency for the 2nd order notch filter on the velocity.
A value of 0 disables the filter.

MPC_XY_CRUISE.longDesc: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently
MPC_XY_CRUISE.shortDesc: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes

MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.longDesc:
The integration speed of the trajectory setpoint is linearly
reduced with the horizontal position tracking error. When the
error is above this parameter, the integration of the
trajectory is stopped to wait for the drone.

This value can be adjusted depending on the tracking
capabilities of the vehicle. Set to 0 to disable the horizontal
time-stretch.
MPC_XY_ERR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum horizontal error allowed by the trajectory generator

MPC_XY_P.longDesc: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error
MPC_XY_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal position error

MPC_XY_TRAJ_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal trajectory position error

MPC_XY_VEL_ALL.longDesc:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_XY_VEL_MAX or MPC_VEL_MANUAL).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative
MPC_XY_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for horizontal velocity error

MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc:
Defined as correction acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral
Allows to eliminate steady state errors in disturbances like wind.
MPC_XY_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for horizontal velocity error

MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all velocity controlled modes.
Any higher value is truncated.

MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error
MPC_XY_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for horizontal velocity error

MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.longDesc:
Limits the acceleration of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.
MPC_YAWRAUTO_ACC.shortDesc: Maximum yaw acceleration in autonomous modes

MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.longDesc:
Limits the rate of change of the yaw setpoint to avoid large
control output and mixer saturation.
MPC_YAWRAUTO_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum yaw rate in autonomous modes

MPC_Z_ERR_MAX.longDesc:
Vertical analog of MPC_XY_ERR_MAX. When the smoothed trajectory z
leads the drone by more than this value, trajectory integration is
slowed down so the virtual setpoint can't walk away from the drone.
This suppresses altitude overshoots caused by a noisy altitude
reference (e.g. mission setpoint jittering as the home altitude
estimate is refined in flight). Set to 0 to disable the vertical
time-stretch.
MPC_Z_ERR_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum vertical error allowed by the trajectory generator

MPC_Z_P.longDesc: Defined as corrective velocity in m/s per m position error
MPC_Z_P.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical position error

MPC_Z_VEL_ALL.longDesc:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative
MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC.shortDesc: Differential gain for vertical velocity error

MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral
MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC.shortDesc: Integral gain for vertical velocity error

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error
MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN.longDesc: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP.longDesc: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

MSP_OSD_CONFIG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run MSP OSD.

MS_ACCEL_RANGE.longDesc:
-1 = Will not be configured, and will use the device default range.
Ranges vary by device and map to integer codes. Check the device's [User Manual](https://www.hbkworld.com/en/products/transducers/inertial-sensors#!ref_microstrain.com) for supported ranges and set the corresponding integer.

bitmask.description: GNSS kinematic (requires motion, e.g. a GNSS velocity)
External Heading (first valid external heading will be used to initialize the filter)

MS_ALIGNMENT.longDesc: Select the source of heading alignment.

MS_BARO_RATE_HZ.longDesc:
Barometer data rate (Hz).
Valid rates: 0 or any factor of 1000.

MS_EHEAD_YAW.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the z axis.
Requires MS_EXT_HEAD_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_EMAG_PTCH.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the y axis.
Requires MS_EXT_MAG_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_EMAG_ROLL.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the x axis.
Requires MS_EXT_MAG_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_EMAG_UNCERT.longDesc:
The 1-sigma uncertainty (in Gauss) for all axes, which will remain constant across all aiding measurements.
Requires MS_EXT_MAG_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_EMAG_YAW.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the z axis.
Requires MS_EXT_MAG_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_EXT_HEAD_EN.longDesc:
Toggles external heading as an aiding measurement.
If enabled, the filter will be configured to accept external heading as an aiding meaurement.

MS_EXT_MAG_EN.longDesc: Toggles external magnetometer aiding in the device filter.

MS_FILT_RATE_HZ.longDesc:
The rate at which the INS data is published (Hz).
Valid rates: 0 or any factor of 1000.

MS_GNSS_AID_SRC.longDesc: Select the source of gnss aiding (GNSS/INS).

MS_GNSS_OFF1_X.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the X direction for the external GNSS receiver.
In the case of a dual antenna setup, this is antenna 1.

MS_GNSS_OFF1_Y.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the Y direction for the external GNSS receiver.
In the case of a dual antenna setup, this is antenna 1.

MS_GNSS_OFF1_Z.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the Z direction for the external GNSS receiver.
In the case of a dual antenna setup, this is antenna 1.

MS_GNSS_OFF2_X.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the X direction for antenna 2
This will only be used if the device supports a dual antenna setup.

MS_GNSS_OFF2_Y.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the Y direction for antenna 2.
This will only be used if the device supports a dual antenna setup.

MS_GNSS_OFF2_Z.longDesc:
Lever arm offset (m) in the X direction for antenna 2.
This will only be used if the device supports a dual antenna setup.

MS_GNSS_RATE_HZ.longDesc:
GNSS receiver 1 and 2 data rate (Hz).
Valid rates: 0, 1 or 5.

MS_GYRO_RANGE.longDesc:
-1 = Will not be configured, and will use the device default range.
Ranges vary by device and map to integer codes. Check the device's [User Manual](https://www.hbkworld.com/en/products/transducers/inertial-sensors#!ref_microstrain.com) for supported ranges and set the corresponding integer.

MS_IMU_RATE_HZ.longDesc:
Accelerometer and Gyroscope data rate (Hz).
Valid rates: 0 or any factor of 1000.

MS_INT_HEAD_EN.longDesc:
Toggles internal heading as an aiding measurement.
If dual antennas are supported (CV7-GNSS/INS). The filter will be configured to use dual antenna heading as an aiding measurement.

MS_INT_MAG_EN.longDesc: Toggles internal magnetometer aiding in the device filter.

MS_MAG_RATE_HZ.longDesc:
Magnetometer data rate (Hz).
Valid rates: 0 or any factor of 1000.

MS_MODE.longDesc:
Sensor mode publishes raw IMU data to be used by EKF2. INS data from the device is published to the external INS topics.
INS mode publishes the INS data to the vehicle topics to be used for navigation.

MS_OFLW_OFF_X.longDesc:
Offset (m) in the X direction if an Optical Flow sensor is connected.
Requires MS_OPT_FLOW_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_OFLW_OFF_Y.longDesc:
Offset (m) in the Y direction if an Optical Flow sensor is connected.
Requires MS_OPT_FLOW_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_OFLW_OFF_Z.longDesc:
Offset (m) in the Z direction if an Optical Flow sensor is connected.
Requires MS_OPT_FLOW_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_OFLW_UNCERT.longDesc:
The 1-sigma uncertainty (in m/s) for the X and Y axes, which will remain constant across all aiding measurements.
The Z axis is not used for aiding.
Requires MS_OPT_FLOW_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_OPT_FLOW_EN.longDesc:
Toggles body frame velocity as an aiding measurement.
The driver uses the body frame velocity from the optical flow sensor as the aiding measurements.

MS_SENSOR_PTCH.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the y axis.
Requires MS_SVT_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_SENSOR_ROLL.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the x axis.
Requires MS_SVT_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_SENSOR_YAW.longDesc:
The orientation of the device (Radians) with respect to the vehicle frame around the z axis.
Requires MS_SVT_EN to be enabled to be used.

MS_SVT_EN.longDesc:
If the sensor has a different orientation with respect to the vehicle. This will enable a transform to correct itself.
The transform is described by MS_SENSOR_ROLL, MS_SENSOR_PITCH, MS_SENSOR_YAW.
MS_SVT_EN.shortDesc: Enables Microstrain sensor to vehicle transform

MXS_EXT_CFG.longDesc: Disables auto-configuration mode enabling MXS config through external software.

MXS_OP_MODE.longDesc: This parameter defines the operating mode of the MXS

MXS_SER_CFG.longDesc: Configure on which serial port to run Sagetech MXS Serial Port.
MXS_SER_CFG.shortDesc: Serial Configuration for Sagetech MXS Serial Port

MXS_TARG_PORT.longDesc: The MXS communication port to receive Target data from

NAV_ACC_RAD.longDesc:
Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set.
For fixed-wing and rovers, the high level controllers output their own acceptance radius. Those values are used instead only when above this parameter.

NAV_DLL_ACT.longDesc:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.
NAV_DLL_ACT.shortDesc: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode

NAV_FORCE_VT.shortDesc: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land

NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.longDesc:
Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller
than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.
NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD.shortDesc: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing

NAV_LOITER_RAD.longDesc:
Default value of loiter radius in fixed-wing mode (e.g. for Loiter mode).

The direction of the loiter can be set via the sign: A positive value for
clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

NAV_LTR_LAST_DL.longDesc:
When the data link is lost and this setting is enabled,
the vehicle will loiter at the position where the last GCS
heartbeat was received rather than at its current position.
Only applies to Hold mode during failsafe actions.
NAV_LTR_LAST_DL.shortDesc: Loiter at last GCS heartbeat position on data link loss

NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.longDesc:
Minimum height above ground the vehicle is allowed to descend to during Mission and RTL,
excluding landing commands.
Requires a distance sensor to be set up.
Note: only prevents the vehicle from descending further, but does not force it to climb.

Set to a negative value to disable.
NAV_MIN_GND_DIST.shortDesc: Minimum height above ground during Mission and RTL

NAV_MIN_LTR_ALT.longDesc:
This is the minimum altitude above Home the system will always obey in Loiter (Hold) mode if switched into this
mode without specifying an altitude (e.g. through Loiter switch on RC).
Doesn't affect Loiters that are part of Missions or that are entered through a reposition setpoint ("Go to").
Set to a negative value to disable.

NAV_RCL_ACT.longDesc:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

"Hold mode (no failsafe)" does not trigger the failsafe: instead, if manual control
is lost while actively flying a manual mode, the vehicle switches to Hold as a regular
mode change (no failsafe state, no alarming notification). If Hold cannot be entered
(e.g. without a valid position estimate), the normal failsafe takes over and escalates
from there (Return/Land/Descend/Terminate as applicable).
NAV_RCL_ACT.shortDesc: Set manual control loss failsafe mode

NAV_TRAFF_AVOID.longDesc:
Enabling this will allow the system to respond
to transponder data from e.g. ADSB transponders

NAV_TRAFF_A_HOR.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID horizontal distance

NAV_TRAFF_A_VER.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID vertical distance

NAV_TRAFF_COLL_T.longDesc:
Minimum acceptable time until collsion.
Assumes constant speed over 3d distance.

NPFG_DAMPING.longDesc: Damping ratio of NPFG control law.

NPFG_LB_PERIOD.longDesc:
Avoids limit cycling from a too aggressively tuned period/damping combination.
If false, also disables upper bound NPFG_PERIOD_UB.
NPFG_LB_PERIOD.shortDesc: Enable automatic lower bound on the NPFG period

NPFG_PERIOD_SF.longDesc:
Multiplied by period for conservative minimum period bounding (when period lower
bounding is enabled). 1.0 bounds at marginal stability.

NPFG_ROLL_TC.longDesc:
Time constant of roll controller command / response, modeled as first order delay.
Used to determine lower period bound. Setting zero disables automatic period bounding.

NPFG_SW_DST_MLT.longDesc:
Multiplied by the track error boundary to determine when the aircraft switches
to the next waypoint and/or path segment. Should be less than 1.

NPFG_UB_PERIOD.longDesc: Adapts period to maintain track keeping in variable winds and path curvature.
NPFG_UB_PERIOD.shortDesc: Enable automatic upper bound on the NPFG period

OSD_ATXXXX_CFG.longDesc:
Configure the ATXXXX OSD Chip (mounted on the OmnibusF4SD board) and
select the transmission standard.

OSD_CH_HEIGHT.longDesc:
Controls the vertical position of the crosshair display.
Resolution is limited by OSD to 15 discrete values. Negative
values will display the crosshairs below the horizon

OSD_DWELL_TIME.longDesc: Amount of time in milliseconds to dwell at the beginning of the display, when scrolling.

OSD_LOG_LEVEL.longDesc: Minimum security of log level to display on the OSD.

OSD_RC_STICK.longDesc: Forward RC stick input to VTX when disarmed

OSD_SCROLL_RATE.longDesc:
Scroll rate in milliseconds for OSD messages longer than available character width.
This is lower-bounded by the nominal loop rate of this module.

PASSTHRU_EN.longDesc:
When enabled, the serial passthrough mode is active and the
normal motor output drivers (dshot, pwm_out) are not started
at boot.

PCA9685_CENT1.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT10.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT11.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT12.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT13.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT14.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT15.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT16.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT2.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT3.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT4.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT5.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT6.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT7.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT8.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_CENT9.longDesc: Servo Center output value (when not disarmed).

PCA9685_DIS1.longDesc:
This is the output value that is set when not armed.

The driver will output standard pulse-width encoded signal without this bit set.
To make PCA9685 output in duty-cycle fashion, please enable the corresponding
channel bit here and adjusting standard params to suit your need.
The driver will have 12bits resolution for duty-cycle output. That means to achieve 0% to 100%
output range on one channel, the corresponding params MIN and MAX for the channel should be set
to 0 and 4096. Other standard params follows the same rule.
PCA9685_DUTY_EN.shortDesc: Put the selected channels into Duty-Cycle output mode

PCA9685_EN_BUS.longDesc:

PCA9685_I2C_ADDR.longDesc:
I2C address of PCA9685.
The default address is 0x40 (64).

PCA9685_PWM_FREQ.longDesc:
Controls the PWM frequency at timing perspective.
This is independent from PWM update frequency, as PCA9685 is capable to output
without being continuously commanded by FC.
Higher frequency leads to more accurate pulse width, but some ESCs and servos may not support it.
This parameter should be set to the same value as PWM update rate in most case.
This parameter MUST NOT exceed upper limit of 400.0, if any outputs as generic 1000~2000us
pulse width is desired. Frequency higher than 400 only makes sense in duty-cycle mode.

PCA9685_REV.longDesc:
Allows to reverse the output range for each channel.
Note: this is only useful for servos.
PCA9685_REV.shortDesc: Reverse Output Range for PCA9685 Output

PCA9685_SCHD_HZ.longDesc:
Controls the update rate of PWM output.
Flight Controller will inform those numbers of update events in a second, to PCA9685.
Higher update rate will consume more I2C bandwidth, which may even lead to worse
output latency, or completely block I2C bus.

PCF8583_MAGNET.longDesc: Number of signals per rotation of actuator

PCF8583_POOL.longDesc: Determines how often the sensor is read out.

PCF8583_RESET.longDesc:
Internal device counter is reset to 0 when overrun this value,
counter is able to store up to 6 digits
reset of counter takes some time - measurement with reset has worse accuracy.
0 means reset counter after every measurement.

PD_GRIPPER_TO.longDesc:
Maximum time Gripper will wait while the successful griper actuation isn't recognised.
If the gripper has no feedback sensor, it will simply wait for
this time before considering gripper actuation successful and publish a
'VehicleCommandAck' signaling successful gripper action
PD_GRIPPER_TO.shortDesc: Timeout for successful gripper actuation acknowledgement

PLD_BTOUT.longDesc: Time after which the landing target is considered lost without any new measurements.

PLD_FAPPR_ALT.longDesc: Allow final approach (without horizontal positioning) if losing landing target closer than this to the ground.

PLD_HACC_RAD.longDesc: Start descending if closer above landing target than this.

PLD_MAX_SRCH.longDesc: Maximum number of times to search for the landing target if it is lost during the precision landing.

PLD_MOVING_T_MAX.longDesc:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the maximum time.

PLD_MOVING_T_MIN.longDesc:
When the landing target is moving, precision land aims at the estimated future
target position after a constrained prediction time. This sets the minimum time.

PLD_SRCH_ALT.longDesc: Altitude above home to which to climb when searching for the landing target.

PLD_SRCH_TOUT.longDesc: Time allowed to search for the landing target before falling back to normal landing.

PLD_YAW_EN.longDesc: Control the orientation when landing. The orientation comes from the topic vte_orientation.
PLD_YAW_EN.shortDesc: Set to true to control yaw while landing

PPS_CAP_ENABLE.longDesc: Enables the PPS capture module to refine the GPS time from pulses detected on a PWM pin configured as "PPS Input".

PPS_CAP_GPS_ID.longDesc:
Device ID of the GPS receiver that emits the PPS signal captured on the
configured PWM input pin. When set to 0 (default), the first available
GPS instance is used.

The device ID can be obtained from the sensor_gps publication
(e.g. via listener sensor_gps).
PPS_CAP_GPS_ID.shortDesc: PPS capture GPS receiver device ID

PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.longDesc: Lower value -> More aggressive controller (beware overshoot/oscillations)
PP_LOOKAHD_GAIN.shortDesc: Tuning parameter for the pure pursuit controller

PP_LOOKAHD_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

PP_LOOKAHD_MIN.shortDesc: Minimum lookahead distance for the pure pursuit controller

RA_ACC_RAD_GAIN.longDesc:
The geometric ideal acceptance radius is multiplied by this factor
to account for kinematic and dynamic effects.
Higher value -> The rover starts to cut the corner earlier.

RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.longDesc:
The controller scales the acceptance radius based on the angle between
the previous, current and next waypoint.
Higher value -> smoother trajectory at the cost of how close the rover gets
to the waypoint (Set to -1 to disable corner cutting).
RA_ACC_RAD_MAX.shortDesc: Maximum acceptance radius for the waypoints

RA_WHEEL_BASE.longDesc: Distance from the front to the rear axle.

RBCLW_COUNTS_REV.longDesc: The default value of 1200 corresponds to the default configuration of the Aion R1 rover.

Use it to arm/disarm via switch instead of default throttle stick. If this is
assigned, arming and disarming via stick is disabled.

RC_MAP_ENG_MOT.shortDesc: RC channel to engage the main motor (for helicopters)

RC_MAP_FAILSAFE.longDesc:
Configures which RC channel is used by the receiver to indicate the signal was lost
(on receivers that use output a fixed signal value to report lost signal).
If set to 0, the channel mapped to throttle is used.

Use RC_FAILS_THR to set the threshold indicating lost signal. By default it's below
the expected range and hence disabled.

RC_MAP_FLTMODE.longDesc:
If this parameter is non-zero, flight modes are only selected
by this channel and are assigned to six slots.

RC_MAP_FLTM_BTN.longDesc:
This bitmask allows to specify multiple channels for changing flight modes using
momentary buttons. Each channel is assigned to a mode slot ((lowest channel = slot 1).
The resulting modes for each slot X is defined by the COM_FLTMODEX parameters.
The functionality can be used only if RC_MAP_FLTMODE is disabled.

The maximum number of available slots and hence bits set in the mask is 6.

RC_MAP_KILL_SW.longDesc:
This channel immediately sets all outputs to their disarmed values, parachutes are NOT deployed.
Unlike termination this can be undone. Quickly flipping the switch back restores control.
System auto-disarms after 5 seconds, preflight checks and re-arming are then required.

RC_MAP_MODE_SW.longDesc:
This is the main flight mode selector.
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for deciding about the main mode.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_PARAM1.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 1st parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM2.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 2nd parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PARAM3.longDesc:
Can be used for parameter tuning with the RC. This one is further referenced as the 3th parameter channel.
Set to 0 to deactivate *

RC_MAP_PITCH.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading pitch inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_ROLL.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading roll inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_TERM_SW.longDesc:
This channel triggers irreversible flight termination:
All outputs are disabled and set to their failsafe values (disarmed by default)
and MAVLink parachutes are triggered.

Unlike a kill switch, this cannot be undone until system reboot. Use with caution.

RC_MAP_THROTTLE.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading throttle inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.

RC_MAP_YAW.longDesc:
The channel index (starting from 1 for channel 1) indicates
which channel should be used for reading yaw inputs from.
A value of zero indicates the switch is not assigned.
